reason: Method relies on intraday order flow, volume profile, bids/offers, and real-time price action reactions that cannot be approximated on daily bars.

setup.rule: Draw reference points on chart for supply/demand
setup.quote: I like to draw reference points either in my mind or on the chart

entry.rule: Short on failure to hold open and lower highs
entry.quote: when it opened it went 88 and then quickly went to 87... that was my cue to start trading on the short side

stop.rule: Exit if price reclaims reference high
stop.quote: if I'm wrong and this thing starts to make highs gets above 88... I'm done

exits.rule: Partial covers at whole dollar levels and volume profile support
exits.quote: they were at whole dollar figures so 83 was a cover there

sizing.rule: Starter position then add to winner, risk X dollars per trade
sizing.quote: I'll put on a starter... as price confirms then I can get bigger

market_filter.rule: High volume confirms fuel for move
market_filter.quote: the more volume that it trades the more it I equate volume with fuel
